caption: The video captures a close-up of a compression-testing setup, where a polished steel platen bears on a reddish-brown sample already split into vertical slivers, with gray crushed powder at the contact zones above a yellow-and-black striped base. Against a fixed cream wall with an arched recess and a striped rod at right, the platen advances slowly downward. The outermost left sliver, leaning outward, rotates progressively, its top edge shifting left and lower. A small fragment on the right breaks away and falls, seen as motion blur at the right edge. The central and right slivers stay standing, the vertical crack between them held open. The left sliver then topples out as a blurred streak, while the debris pile and crushed zone persist with settling.
relations: As the platen advances downward, the outermost left sliver rotates progressively, shifting its top edge left and lower.
Continued platen pressure causes a small right fragment to break away and fall as motion blur.
While the left sliver topples out, the central and right slivers stay standing, holding the vertical crack open.
The left sliver's toppling allows the debris pile and crushed zone to persist with settling.
